# P27.10 (LAUNCH.10) — Custom-domain cut-over to surveillancegraph.org

Points the canonical public origin **`https://surveillancegraph.org`** (+ `www`→apex, HTTP→HTTPS) at
the `sig-web` Cloud Run service with Google-managed TLS, replacing the `*.run.app` URL as the
canonical origin so permalinks/citations/sitemaps resolve to the real domain with no post-launch
churn. The final row of the P27 launch chain. Implements the operator's HG-11 / Go-public gate answer
(GATE DECISIONS 2026-09-23: **"Apply domain mapping now."**). Spec:
`docs/tickets/P27.10__domain-cutover-surveillancegraph.md`. **ADR-098.**

## Summary

- **Mapping approach = external HTTPS Application Load Balancer + serverless NEG** (ADR-098), *not* a
  Cloud Run domain mapping. Empirically forced: under the operator-armed ADC, `gcloud beta run
  domain-mappings create` errors — the domain is unverified and Search Console verification needs an
  interactive step + the `siteverification` scope the cloud-platform ADC lacks (both confirmed
  2026-09-23). The LB needs no verification and reserves a **real static IP** that IS the apex/`www`
  `A`-record value — the only path that fulfills the gate's "apply now, real values from real created
  resources." Cost ~$18/mo — a conscious low-cost departure from SIG-STORE-003 consistent with the
  ADR-081 precedent; ADR-098 records a zero-cost-migration revisit trigger.
- **Applied for real under operator ADC (2026-09-23, `zeta-medley-508121-u7` / `us-central1`):**
  static IP `136.81.80.102`, serverless NEG → `sig-web`, backend, Google-managed cert (apex+www,
  PROVISIONING), HTTPS url map (apex→backend, www→apex 301), HTTP→HTTPS redirect, :443/:80 forwarding
  rules — all idempotent (re-run skips every create). LB `:80` data path live-verified
  (`http://136.81.80.102` Host `surveillancegraph.org` → **301 → https://surveillancegraph.org/**).

## Design decisions

- LB over the zero-cost domain mapping — see Summary + ADR-098 (the mapping is un-appliable now under
  the available ADC; the LB is the only path that produces real values now).
- `www`→apex + HTTP→HTTPS handled at the edge (url-map redirects); `www` is an `A` record (apex can't
  CNAME, LB 301s www→apex). No verification TXT needed.
- The domain + its DNS records are **public config, never secrets** (HG-09) — a literal domain is
  safe; only credentials stay Secret Manager references.
